title: Showtime — The Story Is Ours
summary: Brand and launch campaign for Showtime, an interactive cinema where the audience votes on what happens next.
overview: Showtime is interactive cinema: the audience chooses how the story goes, together, from their phones. We designed the brand and the launch campaign, "The Story Is Ours", for out-of-home and social.

cover.alt: Five Showtime posters lit up in a city bus shelter at dusk on a wet street, with lines like Same screen. A different story. and You're in.

challenge.heading: The brief
body: Help people understand quickly what Showtime is — a film the whole room decides, not a regular movie night.

idea.heading: The approach
body: The O in SHOWTIME is a red dot that splits into choices — A, B or C — so the logo hints at how it works. Short lines like "Same screen. A different story." and "You're in." carry the message.
Black, cream and red with a film-noir style tie the posters, social posts and packaging together. The bus shelter series ends with a QR code to join.

execution.heading: What we delivered
body: Logo and tagline, five out-of-home posters, a six-post Instagram launch, and popcorn and cup packaging.

gallery.alt: Six phones showing the Showtime Instagram launch: the logo under a spotlight, a red-haired woman, a branching A-B-C film strip, a phone vote reading Trust him or Walk away, popcorn packaging, and posters on a brick wall
